correctness.rationale: The definition imposes domination on outside vertices and at most one external neighbor for each selected vertex. Its constraints depend on at most three adjacent two-bit columns. The displayed 16-state pair transfer exactly enumerates every labeled subset with weight z^|D|. The supplied exact Z[z] polynomial calculation checks sixteen u^T T^jR(T)v=0 identities, j=0..15; Cayley–Hamilton propagates this to all j, proving the order-five denominator recurrence for every n, together with exact initial numerator. Independently brute-checked all 4^n subsets for n=1..8 and exact counting totals 3,9,18,43,99,226,517,1187 and min patterns. The crossing cut bound |V\D|<=|D| gives minimum n; equality enforces precisely two full rows or (even n) two 00,11,11,00 alternating patterns. End boundaries n=1 included.

originality.rationale: Tepeh 2026 studies the exact minimum 1-limited domination number on Cartesian grids, including ladder gamma=n, not all-cardinality subset polynomials or the number and types of exact minimizers. Original k-limited domination definitions and ordinary ladder domination polynomials concern different enumerands. No indexed equivalent generating series located; the prior known minimum value is not claimed new.
